findings.title: Item grams are not net gold grams
findings.finding: The seller labels these approximate figures Item Weight. No exact-size, metal-only basis is established. The catalog preserves the stated item grams but leaves net-alloy and fine-gold grams blank.
findings.action: Obtain exact-size total weight and a separate gold-alloy-only weight, excluding stones and other materials. Have an independent jeweler check them before wear or resizing.

findings.title: “Fine Weight” is undefined
findings.finding: Fetched product bodies label ranges Approximate Fine Weight. An older indexed label said Gold Weight. Neither the meaning nor a selected-size value is confirmed. These ranges are not imported as total weight, net-alloy weight or fine-gold mass.
findings.action: Ask Auvere to define the term in writing and supply the exact selected-size metal mass. Do not multiply the range by 22/24 or treat it as pure gold.

findings.title: Incomplete pages: values deliberately withheld
findings.scope: Catbird · four entries; Quince; Auvere prices
findings.finding: Some fetched pages expose price-like strings without a confirmed currency/configuration; others expose specifications but no main-product price. Image filenames, URL slugs, recommendation cards and search snippets do not verify missing fields.
findings.action: Open the official page, select the exact gold configuration and size, and preserve its complete current specifications and final checkout quote. Until then, relevant cells stay blank.

findings.title: Quince uses a platinum head with the gold band
findings.finding: The page offers a 14k gold band with a platinum head, or all platinum. Whole-ring grams would not be an acceptable gold-alloy-only mass. Explicit solid-gold wording and component weights were not confirmed.
findings.action: Request component-specific weights and construction details. Never count the platinum head or diamond as gold.

findings.title: 365-day banner does not apply to engagement rings
findings.finding: The engagement-ring exception is 60 days from purchase, not 365 days from delivery. Made-to-order jewelry is subject to a $35 restocking fee; packaging and certificates matter.
findings.action: Get the exact order’s eligibility, resizing/custom exclusions, refund method and inspection permission in writing before paying.

findings.title: Return-policy mail link contains a typo
findings.finding: The displayed care@automicgold.com text points to a mailto address ending .om in the fetched return policy. The official Contact page separately publishes care@automicgold.com. The policy also says to mail within 14 days to avoid a recycling fee, despite its 30-day return window.
findings.action: Use the checked Contact page, not the malformed mail link. Ask which deadline and fee apply to your order, particularly custom, engraved or modified items.

findings.title: 24k softness is a practical trade-off
findings.finding: The seller states 99.99% purity and warns the ring can bend, warp or scratch easily. Nominal 24/24 is not the same calculation input as a seller-declared 0.9999 fineness.
findings.action: Consider daily-wear suitability with an independent jeweler. Neither purity wording nor a numerical calculation is a physical assay.

findings.title: Crafted-on-Demand price and weight can change
findings.finding: The reviewed pages show USD amounts but no primary-product grams or bound size. Terms permit up to 1g variation for Crafted-on-Demand pieces and a final-price adjustment. Cancellation after shipment or more than 24 hours can incur up to a 10% restocking fee. The return window is not confirmed in captured clauses.
findings.action: Get the final size, weight, total price and applicable return policy before ordering. Buyback is a separate, conditional transaction, not a guaranteed recovery of purchase price.

findings.title: Search and page snapshots disagree
findings.scope: Catbird Odile · Menē Knot · gold reference
findings.finding: Indexed discovery values differed from directly fetched product displays. JM Bullion’s header also differed from its dated body/table ask. Search snippets and separate panels are not silently reconciled or used to pick the lowest price.
findings.action: Use the exact linked product and selected configuration at checkout. The calculator identifies its dated dealer body/table reference and never presents it as live or as an LBMA benchmark.

findings.title: Two inherited settings retained; currency not re-established
findings.finding: Both official pages were rechecked: 14K white gold with rhodium finish; displayed amounts are setting-only and exclude the center stone. The fetched bodies did not explicitly establish USD currency context. The integrated numeric USD price cells remain blank; the preserved original dashboard has been corrected to label currency unconfirmed.
findings.action: Confirm the currency, center diamond, ring size and full-ring checkout total. Do not compare a setting-only display against a complete engagement ring.

findings.title: No candidate has verified paired marks or a physical test
findings.finding: Candidate-specific karat hallmark and maker/manufacturer-mark evidence is absent. No ring was physically inspected, weighed or assayed. A seller’s metal description, a stamp and a review score cannot establish actual purity.
findings.action: Require both marks and independent professional assessment before wearing or resizing. Surface XRF can be misleading on gold-over-gold plating; ask the jeweler which additional assessment is appropriate.

findings.title: Independent inspection and return permission is unconfirmed
findings.finding: Published generic return windows do not establish that a particular order remains returnable after professional testing, resizing or customization. No seller was contacted for written permission during this review.
findings.action: Do not buy under this project’s rules if independent verification and an eligible return are not both allowed. Do not perform destructive tests without authorization.

findings.title: Review channels are not trust or purity certifications
findings.scope: Five independent platforms/profiles; Blue Nile reputation gap
findings.finding: BBB profiles/complaints and Menē’s Trustpilot channel were read. These contain opinions or allegations, not independently established assay findings. Non-accreditation alone is not wrongdoing. Scores and complaint counts were not imported as purchase ratings. No independent Blue Nile reputation review was completed in this extension. Independent reputation also remains unassessed for VRAI, Brilliant Earth and Zales.
findings.action: Read multiple independent sources, assess seller responses and validate contact details. A published phone/email does not prove a working business; no calls or emails were made.

findings.title: No licensed numeric LBMA benchmark; dealer quote is dated
findings.finding: LBMA’s public page did not expose a licensed numeric gold price. A dated JM Bullion body/table ask is recorded separately, with a conflicting header flagged. It is a dealer reference, not a guaranteed liquidation payout or a live feed.
findings.action: Refresh the relevant source manually before a buying decision. Raw-gold values for catalog products stay blank until an admissible net metal weight and purity basis exist.

findings.title: Excluded discovery lead: Auvere Maze page unavailable
findings.finding: The official URL returned not-found content. No old indexed weight or price was imported; this is an excluded research lead, not a current listing.
findings.action: Find a working official replacement before adding a candidate. A link checker should report this known unavailable lead, not silently remove the flag.

findings.title: All concurrent-session listings retained without filling gaps
findings.finding: The previously published 16-entry root register was combined with the 16 new product pages. Shared Blue Nile settings are deduplicated. Official product pages were directly rechecked. Dollar-symbol displays are preserved as source observations but not normalized to USD without currency evidence. No Zales color or unselected-center origin is inferred.
findings.action: Use the complete combined register rather than adding the two historical dashboards together. Inspect exact SKU, metal, selected size and native currency on the official page.

findings.title: VRAI metal weight is size-specific; returns have a fee
findings.finding: The seller states Metal weight: 2.86g (Ring size 6). This is not an independently verified measurement and cannot be generalized to all sizes. The full return policy specifies a $300 engagement-ring recycling fee and excludes modified/resized, third-party-altered and custom items.
findings.action: Preserve the ring-size-6 context and confirm the actual ordered weight, refund method and permission for testing. Automatic verified fine-gold values remain blank.

findings.title: WGC chart date does not date its moving header quote
findings.finding: Earlier sessions recorded a WGC header value with a 22 October quote-date label while the chart said data as of 21 October. The current moving header differs again. Chart metadata and a header price are separate panels; neither the retrieval date nor the chart date proves the header quote timestamp.
findings.action: Keep an unknown source quote-as-of date blank, distinguish it from the observation date, and preserve the discrepancy. The expanded calculator uses its separately identified dated dealer body/table reference, not an inferred WGC timestamp.

findings.title: Do not choose a diamond origin for an unselected center
findings.scope: Bare settings and incomplete diamond-origin evidence
findings.finding: A bare setting can accept different center stones. A diamond in a product name does not establish natural versus lab-grown origin. Incomplete Catbird and Zales origin evidence is grouped as unconfirmed instead of being asserted as natural.
findings.action: Confirm the exact center/accent stone description and full-ring scope. Category placement is a research organizer, not a gemological finding.

findings.title: VRAI Plain band selection also displays a pavé specification
findings.finding: The fetched selected configuration says Plain band but also displays Pavé carat weight:0.18 ctw. The correspondence of this field to the selected variant is unconfirmed. No pavé weight or diamond mass is used in any ring-gold calculation.
findings.action: Have the seller confirm the exact plain/pavé configuration, size-specific metal-only weight, chosen center and all-in native-currency quote in writing.

findings.title: Re-observation on 2026-10-23 changed several displayed values
findings.scope: Menē Rose Ring · Menē Knot Ring · Brilliant Earth Classic Six-Prong · dealer gold reference
findings.finding: Direct official-page fetches on 2026-10-23 replaced earlier dated observations: Menē Rose Ring $1,346 → $1,336 and Menē Knot Ring $1,465 → $1,454 (both USD, Crafted-on-Demand); Brilliant Earth's Classic Six-Prong setting rendered in a USD locale as $890 (Setting Only) instead of the 2026-10-22 EUR-locale €990.00; the JM Bullion dealer reference moved from $4,039.76 to $4,035.54 and the World Gold Council moving header changed again within the same day. Each figure is a dated display observation, not a fixed price; nothing was converted between currencies or averaged.
findings.action: Re-open each official page and the cart for the exact configuration before deciding. Treat every amount here as dated, record the observation date with any comparison, and never treat a locale change as an exchange-rate conversion.

findings.title: Labeled amounts now render where the register previously recorded none
findings.scope: Zales 1/5 CT. Diamond Solitaire · Catbird Odile the Swan · Sonnet · Night at the Ballet (Emerald Cut) · Pointelle
findings.finding: The 2026-10-23 fetches showed amounts where earlier captures recorded none or unlabelled text: Zales V-19957449 "Discounted Price $899.00"; Catbird Odile the Swan "from$1,600.00", Sonnet $2,800.00, Night at the Ballet Emerald Cut "from$5,300.00" and Pointelle $578.00. Catbird's own site asks visitors to choose a shipping country and currency, and Zales shows no ISO code in the retrieved text, so the structured price and currency fields remain blank and the raw displays are preserved only as dated observations.
findings.action: Confirm the currency, chosen size/finish/carat and the all-in cart total on the official page before any comparison. A displayed dollar sign is not treated as a verified USD total, and variant-dependent 'from' amounts are not minimum prices for a chosen configuration.

findings.title: Sarraf internal engraving/warranty conflicts and size-10 gram benchmark
findings.finding: Sarraf publishes explicit '14K Solid Gold', 'US$' prices, and separate 'Approximate Metal Weight' in grams, and holds an A+ BBB profile since 1998, but product tabs conflict with /about-sarraf/ on engraved ring returns and SAR-144773's 13.40g mass is benchmarked at size 10.
findings.action: Confirm exact gram mass for your ring size in writing before checkout and inspect on a calibrated scale + XRF prior to any engraving or resizing.

findings.title: Factory Direct Jewelry FDJ-GR0001: 1.25g displayed mass w/ 1.37ctw diamonds & 1.8/5 BBB score
findings.finding: Despite '14K Solid Gold' and 'Karat stamped inside the band.', default weight reads 'Weight:1.25 Grams' alongside 1.37cts of diamonds (0.976g net metal if gross) and LA BBB shows Not Accredited, 1.8/5 reviews, and 11 complaints.
findings.action: Do not treat solid-gold wording alone as durability proof; reject ultra-light settings and verify independent complaint records.

findings.title: Stone and Strand SS-MIA 14K vs 10K conflict and Final Sale return ban
findings.finding: SS-MIA lists 'Gold Karat: 14K' in specs against '10K Yellow Gold' image alt tags, and >=50%-off items (SS-MIA, SS-RITA) are non-returnable Final Sale.
findings.action: Walk away from any Final Sale online listing that disallows return after independent post-arrival XRF verification.

findings.title: Root-register product pages were absent from the combined catalog (resolved 2026-10-23)
findings.finding: A provenance scan on 2026-10-23 found AG-COFFIN-RING, AG-CUSHION-SIGNET and MJ-BOLD-ETERNITY in the root register but not in the then-41-product combined catalog. Session S-1EB9F828 integrated all three with their own dated, field-scoped evidence, a new F-039 variant-price-scope flag, and a QA cross-register check (tools/qa.py check 12). The combined catalog now carries 44 products across 13 sellers. The identity-only source links and this historical observation are retained; no price or physical gold claim is established by the original finding.
findings.action: Keep tools/qa.py check 12 in place so any root-register source URL missing from the combined catalog fails CI. Recheck for hallucinations after any integration; never copy a value without re-verifying the official field source.

findings.title: A karat sentence was published as a verbatim quote from pages that do not contain it
findings.scope: Gold reference — karat basis (16 CFR 23.3 and FTC consumer guidance)
findings.finding: The stored karat basis carried 'an item marked 18 k is made of 75 % gold' as a field-scoped excerpt attributed to the eCFR section and, in the evidence file, to the NIST conversion chart. On 2026-10-23 both the regulation and the FTC article were re-read: the regulation contains no such sentence and the FTC article expresses the same fact in parts ('18 parts gold mixed with six parts of another metal'), which makes 75 % arithmetic rather than a quotation. The sentence was removed and replaced with verified text; the arithmetic stays, clearly labelled.
findings.action: Quote only text present in a dated fetch, and label derived percentages as derived. Re-run a string-matching hallucination scan after every review — a plausible quotation is exactly what an unchecked pipeline propagates.

findings.title: Evening 2026-10-23 re-observation supersedes the same-day JM Bullion dealer reference
findings.finding: S-C74095E5 re-read the JM Bullion gold chart page in the evening pass of 2026-10-23: the page (own timestamp 19:46 EDT = 23:46Z) displayed 'Gold Ask $4,009.38', superseding the 05:56 EDT observation of $4,035.54 recorded earlier the same day. The same evening's WGC header ($3,995.47) and Menē movements were convergently re-observed and recorded by S-88AA65FD. Superseded amounts remain only in dated notes/history, never as current values.
findings.action: Treat all gold-linked display prices as dated snapshots; re-read the official page before any purchase decision.

findings.title: Sarraf SAR-147371 states diamond color G and H on the same page
findings.finding: The SAR-147371 product page states 'Diamond Color: G' in its specifications and 'I1 in clarity and H in color' in its description. Neither color is recorded as confirmed; see root flag F-045.
findings.action: Obtain written confirmation of the diamond color from Sarraf before purchase and verify the stone independently on arrival.
